title: Hammond Police Division sitemap
key_finding: The City of Hammond currently publishes an official police-division sitemap with active division pages, showing that Hammond still maintains a municipal police organization rather than relying exclusively on the parish sheriff.

title: Hammond Municipal Fire and Police Civil Service
key_finding: The city maintains a Hammond Municipal Fire and Police Civil Service page describing the city's classified fire and police service, which is direct official evidence of an ongoing municipal police structure.

title: Hammond Police Department UCR 2017-2021
publisher: City of Hammond / Hammond Police Department
key_finding: Hammond Police Department published an official city-hosted UCR / Crime Stats PDF through 2021, proving that Hammond historically operated a real municipal crime-publication surface.

title: Couple Arrested in Drug Investigation
key_finding: TPSO's own 2025 news release says the sheriff's office worked in collaboration with the Hammond Police Department, which confirms separate active agencies rather than sheriff replacement of city policing.

title: Crime in Louisiana 2023
publisher: Louisiana Commission on Law Enforcement and Louisiana Sheriff's Association
key_finding: The official Louisiana annual report lists Hammond P.D. in the LIBRS participation roster for Tangipahoa Parish, but a packet review of the public PDF did not recover a Hammond city offense row from the published agency tables, indicating a public publication gap or omission rather than disappearance of the agency.

title: FBI CDE Agency Roster 2024 Louisiana mirror
publisher: FBI Crime Data Explorer mirrored in repo
key_finding: The 2024 FBI CDE roster includes both Hammond Police Department (LA0530100, city agency, NIBRS start 2021-01-01) and Tangipahoa Parish Sheriff's Office (LA0530000), which supports active parallel city and parish law-enforcement entities.

title: agency_to_jurisdiction_crosswalk.csv
key_finding: The live crosswalk routes LA0530100 exclusively to 22:municipal:place:2232755, indicating a clean Hammond municipal mapping rather than a mixed sheriff-city geometry.

title: canonical_agency_year_2018_2024.parquet
key_finding: LA0530100 carries positive annual Part I totals in 2018-2022, then flips to zero-count rows with months_reported = 0 in 2023 and 2024, which is a continuity break on a real agency row.

title: jurisdiction_controls_2024.parquet
key_finding: All 2024 Hammond city offense controls are sourced from zero-support SRS annual rows and fully filled from trend_log_linear estimates anchored to usable history through 2022.

title: municipal_target_review_queue.csv
key_finding: Hammond is queued as a high-impact full-fill municipal review case with total_reported_count = 0 and fill_share_of_estimated = 1.0 across the surfaced review offenses.
